events.title: Theos: Cities of Myth Demo - A New Hotfix is here!
events.summary: The Gods have heard you! We just applied a new hotfix to Theos: Cities of Myth to address some of the issues reported in the demo:Fixed a crash that occurred when minimizing the game with DirectX 12 settings enabled and in full-screen mode.Fixed a crash that occurred when skipping the tutorial with flat mode enabled.Thank you for your precious support! Enjoy the demo and join us on Discord to keep sharing your feedback with us!

events.title: Our New Release Date Trailer is Here to Celebrate a November 2026 Launch!
events.summary: We’re beyond thrilled to let you know that Theos: Cities of Myth will enter the agora on November 4, 2026!Check out our new trailer here, and prepare to dive into our vision of Ancient Greece - where history and mythology walk hand in hand!Join our official Discord today, and we’ll see you in the Acropolis soon!

events.title: Adventure and Sandbox: Two Ways to Experience Theos: Cities of Myth
events.summary: Theos: Cities of Myth offers two complementary ways to build your civilization: Adventure and Sandbox. Here you will find a brief breakdown of the features each mode offers to aspiring Founders. events.title: Theos: Cities of Myth - Gameplay Trailer
events.summary: Welcome to Ancient Greece, Founders! Join us today as we dive into your very first look at the gameplay of Theos: Cities of Myth, the all-new city-builder from the makers of Pharaoh: A New Era! Check out the trailer, get a taste of what’s coming, and tell us in the comments: which Olympian God will you dedicate your first Polis to?

events.title: Walkers: The Lifeblood of Your Polis
events.summary: A thriving city is more than a collection of buildings. To keep your citizens safe and prosperous, you need to provide them with goods and services. That's where Walkers come in.Different types of buildings generate different Walkers, each with a specific purpose. Some help protect your population from risks such as fires, crime, building deterioration, or disease. Others distribute essential resources like water and food.
